response.sql: WITH order_genders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, c.gender FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id), gender_counts AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) as count FROM order_genders GROUP BY gender), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM gender_counts), gender_shares AS (SELECT gc.gender, gc.count, CAST(gc.count AS DECIMAL(38,20)) / CAST(tc.total AS DECIMAL(38,20)) as share FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN total_count tc), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM gender_shares) SELECT gs.gender, gs.count, gs.share, gs.share - avg.avg_share as above_average FROM gender_shares gs CROSS JOIN average_share avg WHERE gs.share > avg.avg_share
